Spin-off from: https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/issues/892#issuecomment-808788466

Problem to solve: there are security logs, which need to exists, but often developers "forget" debug logs on and those logs contain a lot of sensitive information, are not sanitized (cleaned from sensitive information) and quite soon those log contain too much data which is outside of application authorization flow.

Proposal:
* Requirement: Verify that the application does not log anything extra then described in log inventory.
* Level: 2
* CWE-779 Logging of Excessive Data
